SELECT "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:leads}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("company"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'company' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "company" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'company' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "company" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'score' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "score" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'score' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "score" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'estimated_value' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "estimated_value" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'estimated_value' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "estimated_value" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:leads}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("company"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:leads}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:leads}} ("name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::int, $8::numeric, $9::int, $10::text, $11::timestamptz, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:leads}}
SET "name" = $2::text, "company" = $3::text, "email" = $4::text, "phone" = $5::text, "source" = $6::text, "status" = $7::text, "score" = $8::int, "estimated_value" = $9::numeric, "owner_id" = $10::int, "notes" = $11::text, "last_contact_at" = $12::timestamptz, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:leads}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:leads}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "name"::text AS label FROM {{table:leads}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "name" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:leads}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
UPDATE {{table:leads}} SET "owner_id" = $2::int, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "owner_id"
UPDATE {{table:leads}} SET "score" = $2::numeric, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "score"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("estimated_value"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("estimated_value"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'new')::int AS status_new, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'contacted')::int AS status_contacted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'qualified')::int AS status_qualified, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'unqualified')::int AS status_unqualified, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'converted')::int AS status_converted
FROM {{table:leads}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("estimated_value"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:leads}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:leads}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT "id", "name", "company", "email", "phone", "source", "status", "score", "estimated_value", "owner_id", "notes", "last_contact_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:leads}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND "last_contact_at" IS NOT NULL
  AND "last_contact_at" < now() - ($1::int || ' days')::interval
  AND "status" NOT IN ('')
ORDER BY "last_contact_at" ASC LIMIT 100
